test_title: PYST 35: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following cell organelles is filled with digestive enzymes and helps to keep the cell clean by digesting any foreign material as well as worn out cell organelles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysosomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lysosomes** are membrane-bound cell organelles that contain **digestive enzymes**. These enzymes break down excess or worn-out cell parts, as well as foreign invaders like bacteria or viruses.
 
• They act as the **clean-up system of the cell** by digesting and removing cellular debris and foreign materials, ensuring the cell remains healthy and free from harmful substances.
 
• The enzymes in lysosomes are capable of digesting **proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, and nucleic acids**, which makes them essential for cellular metabolism and recycling.
 
• Lysosomes are often referred to as the **"suicidal bags of the cell"** because they can self-destruct by releasing their enzymes if the cell is damaged or in a state of emergency.
 
• Their role in **autophagy (self-eating)** is crucial for the recycling of old or damaged organelles, maintaining cellular health and energy balance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chloroplast:**

 
 
• Chloroplasts are **green, double-membrane organelles** found in plant cells and some algae.
 
• They are responsible for **photosynthesis**, a process that converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.
 
• Chloroplasts contain the pigment **chlorophyll**, which captures light energy.
 
• They are not involved in the digestion or recycling of cellular materials.
 
 
 
• **Ribosome:**
 
 
• Ribosomes are the **protein synthesis machinery** of the cell, either floating freely in the cytoplasm or attached to the rough endoplasmic reticulum.
 
• They are composed of **ribosomal RNA (rRNA) and proteins**.
 
• They are not involved in cellular digestion or cleaning functions.
 
 
 
• **Chromoplast:**
 
 
• Chromoplasts are specialized organelles in plants that contain pigments other than chlorophyll, such as **carotenoids**, which give fruits and flowers their bright colors.
 
• They play a role in **attracting pollinators** but do not have any role in cellular digestion or cleaning.
 
 
 
• **Functions of Lysosomes:**
 
 
• Lysosomes help in **defense mechanisms** by digesting harmful bacteria and viruses.
 
• They are involved in **programmed cell death (apoptosis)**, which is essential for the removal of damaged cells in multicellular organisms.
 
• They contribute to **metabolic processes** by breaking down macromolecules into their monomers for reuse by the cell.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The term **"lysosome"** was coined by Belgian biologist **Christian de Duve** in 1955, who discovered them during his studies on cellular enzymes.
 
• Lysosomes are most abundant in cells that perform **phagocytosis**, such as white blood cells, which engulf and digest pathogens.
 
• Defects in lysosomal enzymes can lead to diseases such as **Lysosomal Storage Disorders** (e.g., Tay-Sachs disease).
